test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

They bought ______ tickets instead from a sleepy-looking guard.
solution:
The correct answer is "**their**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given sentence, the correct word to use in the blank is "their."**
 
• **"Their" is the possessive form of the third-person plural pronoun “they.” It means “belonging to them.”**(उ
